name: Naïve
long_description:
Naïve is the easiest way to give an AI agent everything it needs to act in the real world. Each agent gets its own isolated operator — a verified identity (KYC or EIN), spend-limited card, email inbox, phone number, and access to thousands of tools — one API, one credit balance. 

Declare an agent's identity, money, and permissions as code, then provision one agent or a million, each scoped and governed per end-user, with a control layer that audits and can revoke every action.

We are a fast-moving, small, remote-first team.
